results.name: Tomb of Tu Duc
results.description:
*Tomb of Tự Đức (Vietnamese: Lăng Tự Đức), officially Khiêm Mausoleum (Khiêm Lăng, Hán tự: 謙陵), is located in Huế, Vietnam. It is built for the Nguyễn Emperor Tự Đức and took three years to build from 1864–1867. It is divided into a Temple Area and a Tomb Area.*

*Emperor Tu Duc enjoyed the longest reign of any monarch of the Nguyen dynasty, ruling from 1848-1883. Although he had 104 wives and concubines, he was unable to father a son (possibly he became sterile after contracting smallpox). Thus, it fell to him to write his own epitaph on the deeds of his reign.* https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tomb_of_T%E1%BB%B1_%C4%90%E1%BB%A9c


CyArk 2019: Complex of Hué Monuments - Tomb of Tu Duc - Collected by CyArk. Distributed by Open Heritage 3D. https://doi.org/10.26301/n06n-qa49

results.name: Cai Mep Port, Vietnam
results.description:
Cái Mép Port, a significant deep-water port located in Phú Mỹ, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu Province, Vietnam. As part of the Cái Mép–Thị Vải port complex, it ranks among the world’s top 30 largest container ports. The port is capable of accommodating vessels up to 200,000 DWT and plays a crucial role in Vietnam’s international trade, offering direct shipping routes to Europe and North America. Its strategic location near industrial zones and major highways enhances its importance as a logistics hub in Southeast Asia.

To create this model, I used videos by Toàn BDS, available at https://www.pexels.com/@toanbds668/gallery/?filter=videos

Google Maps to this place — [link](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ktEjEX4euZhbYJTd6).

Model made from 6910 4K frames of videos.  
Original recalculated model has 388.8M polygons.

results.name: Hoa Khiem Temple - Tomb of Emperor Tu Duc
results.description: The Complex of Hué Monuments is located within the Thua Thien-Hue Province in the geographical center of Vietnam. Established as the capital of unified Vietnam in 1802, Hue was not only the political but also the cultural and religious center under the Nguyen dynasty until 1945. The Hué Monuments Complex has suffered from the effects of wars, as well as modern development and expanding human settlements. The Tu Duc Tomb is the final resting place of Emperor Tu Duc who reigned from 1848 until his death in 1883. Tu Duc faced encroaching colonialism from the west as well as turmoil within the Vietnam, particularly related to the construction of his tomb. In attempt reduce the construction time, managers of the project reduced the timeline from six to three years by eliminating laborers' breaks, resulting in a rebellion. After a short delay, construction resumed, culminating in a park-like tomb complex designed to reflect Tu Duc’s extensive education in history, philosophy, literature, and art.

results.name: Royal Nghe Statue - Hue Imperial City
results.description:
Royal Nghe Statue - Hue Imperial City | Tượng Nghê Điện Thái Hòa - Linh vật cung đình Huế

A detailed 3D reconstruction of the Nghe statue at Thai Hoa Palace, located within the Hue Imperial City (UNESCO Heritage). In Vietnamese culture, the Nghe is a mythical creature symbolizing wisdom, loyalty, and majesty, traditionally placed in royal spaces for protection. This model showcases the sophisticated bronze craftsmanship of the Nguyen Dynasty. Ideal for digital museums, architectural studies, and Vietnamese cultural projects.

Mô hình 3D phục dựng chi tiết tượng Nghê tại Điện Thái Hòa, thuộc quần thể di sản cố đô Huế. Trong văn hóa Việt Nam, Nghê là linh vật biểu tượng cho sự thông minh, trung thành và uy nghiêm, thường được đặt tại các không gian cung đình để canh giữ và trừ tà. Mô hình tái hiện nghệ thuật đúc đồng và tạo hình tinh xảo thời triều Nguyễn. Phù hợp cho bảo tàng số, nghiên cứu kiến trúc và văn hóa Việt Nam.

results.name: A sample of South Vietnam temple
results.description: Temple architecture in southern Vietnam is a blend of Huế (Central Vietnam) architecture and the architecture of Chinese immigrants. Common features include spacious, low-ceilinged buildings with verandas, multiple roofs; the roof and walls of the house are decorated with many intricate patterns in vibrant colors; and a layout consisting of a front building, an intermediate building, and a main building at the rear.

results.name: Vietnam - Ly Dynasty One Pillar Pagoda
results.description:
Diên Hựu Buddhist Temple (延祐寺), the temple with the One Pillar Pagoda you see today in Hanoi, is one of the most famous Buddhist temples in Vietnam. According to the Complete Annals of Đại Việt (大越史記全書), it was built in 1049 by the order of Emperor Lý Thái Tông (李太宗). The model you are watching is a Minecraft simulation of Ly Dynasty's look of it based on the original 3D simulated model made by Sen Heritage.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/One_Pillar_Pagoda
